**Spec:** [`docs/CL_SPECIFICATION.md`](docs/CL_SPECIFICATION.md). **Decisions:** [`docs/CL_DECISIONS.md`](docs/CL_DECISIONS.md). **Findings:** [`docs/CL_FINDINGS.md`](docs/CL_FINDINGS.md). **Agent rules:** [`CLAUDE.md`](CLAUDE.md). **Shared phase instructions:** [`prompts/CL_shared-instructions.md`](prompts/CL_shared-instructions.md)
**Last updated:** 2026-10-20 11:16 CDT (project prefix and timestamps)

> ⚠️ **Mandatory:** every agent that works on this project keeps this file accurate. **Before doing any other work, set your phase to `🔄 In progress` and commit that change to `main`** (claim protocol: `prompts/CL_shared-instructions.md` §1a). Other agents read this table from `main`. At the end, set it to `✅ Complete` or `⛔ Blocked` and add a Phase Log entry. See `CLAUDE.md`.

## How to run a phase
Open Claude Code in `/home/nick/Work/chessloopDeploy` and type one of:
- `/phase`: run the next eligible phase. It checks dependencies, tells you if you're on the wrong model, resumes an `In progress` phase, and asks about any open questions it needs.
- `/phase NN`: run a specific phase.
- `/phase status`: show progress and what's next, without doing any work.
- `/phase-add [after NN] <request>`: plan a new lettered phase (for example `08a`) without building it.

Review the agent's close-out summary, then merge the phase branch when satisfied. Phases that change the product also open a PR on `antonizick/chessloop`. The agent pushes, opens and merges it only after you say OK in that session (ADR-0003).

Each phase is claimed by a `chore(plan): start phase NN` commit on `main` and runs in its own worktree, `../chessloopDeploy-phase-NN` (plus `/home/nick/Work/chessloop-phase-NN` for product changes), so parallel sessions never share a checkout. `/phase status` flags any branch or worktree whose row is not `🔄 In progress`.

**Parallelism.** 01 and 03 can start at once (01 → 02 is the upstream track; 03 is the lab). 04 and 05 run in parallel after 03. 06 and 07 run in parallel after 02 + 04. Everything from 08 onward is sequential.

**Status values:** ⬜ Not started · 🔄 In progress · ⛔ Blocked · ✅ Complete. Always write the icon **and** the word.

### Model rationale
- **Opus 5.5** (`/model claude-opus-5-5`) where judgment or subtle correctness matters: observing and classifying failures as a novice would (04, 05, 11); auth and security code (06); data-volume safety and nginx security (07); the installer, a bash state machine that installs system packages and touches user data (08, 09); the security review (12).
- **Sonnet 5.5** (`/model claude-sonnet-5-5`) for well-specified work: governance files (01), CI wiring (02), lab scaffolding (03), docs authoring against a verified tool (10), and the guided release (13).

## Phase Log
Newest entries at the bottom. Format: `### YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ: Phase NN: <title> (<status>)` (new entries use a timestamp from `date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z'`; entries written before 2026-10-20 carry a date only). **The first bullet is always the Timeline:** `- **Timeline:** started <TS> (claim commit <hash>) · finished <TS> · merged <TS | not merged yet>` (add ` · blocked <TS> to <TS>` per `⛔` interval; *started* is the claim commit's time, *finished* is `date` as the last step). Entries written before 2026-10-20 have no Timeline bullet; the dates come from git., then bullets: built, deviations, follow-ups, tests.

### 2026-10-16: Phase 02: Upstream CI & quality gates (✅ Complete)
- **Built (product branch `deploy/phase-02-ci`, squash-merged as [antonizick/chessloop#14](https://github.com/antonizick/chessloop/pull/14), merge commit `802de01`):** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with jobs backend (Python 3.12, pytest, `CHESSLOOP_EMAIL_MX_CHECK=false`), frontend (Node 24 LTS, `npm ci`, lint, build), shell (ShellCheck v0.11.0, `continue-on-error`), compose (prod and dev `config -q`), images (backend and frontend, buildx `type=gha` cache) and secrets (gitleaks v8.30.1, full history). `permissions: contents: read`, no secrets used. `scripts/ci-local.sh` (Docker-based, per-step selection, summary), `.gitleaks.toml`, README CI badge, CONTRIBUTING CI section, CHANGELOG entry.
- **Pins (looked up 2026-10-16 via `gh api`):** checkout v7.0.1 `3d3c42e`, setup-python v7.0.0 `5fda3b9`, setup-node v7.1.0 `949feb2`, setup-buildx-action v4.4.1 `f87e5991`, build-push-action v7.4.0 `c3c9e26`; ShellCheck and gitleaks as image digests. Node 24 "Krypton" is the Active LTS per nodejs.org/dist/index.json (Node 20 is the one the Dockerfile still uses; Phase 07).
- **Deviations:** (1) No test needed fixing; the tests already set `CHESSLOOP_EMAIL_MX_CHECK=false`, so no `xfail`. (2) `.gitleaks.toml` has no allow-list: the history scan (140 commits) found no leaks, so there was no placeholder to allow. (3) Images job uses `docker/build-push-action` per image instead of `docker compose build`, to get a GHA layer cache (compose build has no cache option without editing the file). (4) `actions/cache` is not used; setup-python and setup-node cache built in.
- **Findings:** F-001 (ShellCheck: 14 diagnostics, advisory), F-002 (939 `utcnow()` deprecation warnings, accepted); H15 gained evidence (compose `version` warning).
- **GitHub run on the PR:** all required jobs passed (backend 47 s, frontend 26 s, compose 8 s, images 56 s and 52 s, gitleaks 7 s); advisory ShellCheck failed as expected (F-001).
- **Follow-ups:** Phase 12 makes the checks required and flips `shell` to blocking. Dependabot already covers `github-actions`.
- **Tests:** `scripts/ci-local.sh` on the laptop: backend 72 passed (0 xfailed, 55 s), frontend lint and build OK (28 s), shell WARN (advisory), compose OK, images OK (87 s cold), secrets no leaks; total 2 m 52 s. ShellCheck on `scripts/ci-local.sh` is clean.

### 2026-10-16: Phase 03: Test lab (Incus) (✅ Complete)
- **Built:** `lab/lab.sh` (create, reset, destroy, shell, exec, root, ip, push, pull, list), `lab/platforms.conf`, `lab/incus-preseed.yaml`, `lab/lib/{scrub,test-scrub,timing,evidence,run-capture}.sh` with fixtures, `lab/drive-deploy.exp`, `lab/smoke.sh`, `lab/mailpit/setup.sh`, `lab/lint.sh` (ShellCheck in a digest-pinned container), `docs/LAB.md`, ADR-0013, OSMods note `Incus Test Lab.md` plus README entries.
- **Host:** Incus 7.4.0-1 (pacman), group `incus-admin`, socket-activated, bridge `clbr0` 10.77.0.0/24 NAT-only, btrfs pool `lab` (sparse 150 GiB loop file), three ufw rules for `clbr0` only. Nick ran the sudo commands himself.
- **Images (fingerprints, 2026-10-16):** Ubuntu noble cloud `1950711f7883`, Debian bookworm cloud `9a37e5cbf2d1`, Debian trixie cloud `6d2c6fde5e02`. VMs: 2 vCPU, 4 GiB, 25 GiB. Mailpit v1.31.6 in VM `cl-mailpit` at 10.77.0.2 (1 vCPU, 512 MiB).
- **Measured:** `reset` 11-16 s (6 runs, 3 platforms); destroy+create 46-51 s with images cached. Two full rounds of reset, destroy, create passed for all three platforms. Verified: systemd PID 1, `sam` with password sudo (wrong password refused), no Docker, outbound HTTPS (raw `deploy.sh` fetched, 947 lines), Mailpit reachable from host and VMs, no Mailpit listener on the host (`ss -tlnp`: only Incus dnsmasq on 10.77.0.1:53).
- **Tests:** `lab/lint.sh` clean (9 files); `lab/lib/test-scrub.sh` PASS; `drive-deploy.exp` exercised in a VM against a fake script (menu, sudo password, directory and bind answers; unknown prompt exits 4); `smoke.sh` run against the product backend alone (Docker, loopback): with SMTP and MX check off, 9 steps PASS and admin login `FAIL (expected: H1)`; with defaults, `verify_email`/`user_login` `FAIL (expected: H3)`. These are backend-level observations only; Phase 04 still owes the VM confirmation, so `docs/CL_FINDINGS.md` statuses are unchanged. The full installer was not run (Phase 04).
- **Deviations:** (1) Mailpit runs in its own VM, not a container: containers failed with "System doesn't have a functional idmap setup" and fixing that needs root subuid/subgid on the host (ADR-0013). (2) ufw blocked DHCP/forwarding on `clbr0`; the three ufw rules were added. (3) Instance names use dashes (`cl-ubuntu-24-04`) because Incus rejects dots. (4) `sam` is not uid 1000 on Ubuntu (the `ubuntu` user is), so `lab.sh` looks the uid up. (5) The OSMods index file is `OSMODs README.md`, not `README.md`.
- **Follow-ups:** the host has no `shellcheck`; `lab/lint.sh` uses Docker. Phase 04 must set the app's SMTP to 10.77.0.2:1025 for mail paths (`CHESSLOOP_SMTP_HOST`, `_PORT`, `_USE_TLS=false`). `smoke.sh` defaults the admin email to `admin@example.com` and takes the password from `SMOKE_ADMIN_PASSWORD`; Phase 06 changes how admin is created. Phase 05 can reuse `lab/lib` and the bridge for the Windows VM.
- **PR:** none (planning only).

### 2026-10-16: Phase 04: Baseline audit on Linux (✅ Complete)
- **Built:** `docs/BASELINE-LINUX.md` (platform × path matrix, timings, top-10 pain points, 22 doc inaccuracies, recommendations per phase); 33 new findings F-003…F-035 in `docs/CL_FINDINGS.md` (**5 Blocker, 14 Major, 13 Minor, 1 Polish**); every H row resolved (H1–H18, H20 Confirmed; H21 Fixed earlier; H19 is WSL-only and stays for Phase 05; none refuted). Lab tooling: `lab/baseline.sh` (one command per audit step, `all` runs the whole sequence), `lab/sabotage.sh` (7 sabotage cases), `lab/ui-shots.py` (headless screenshots), `SAM_PASSWORD_FIRST` in `drive-deploy.exp`, platform `ubuntu-24.04-2g`, `lab.sh ip` fixed. 25 evidence directories under `runs/2026-10-16-*`. ADR-0014 (audit method).
- **Product under test:** `antonizick/chessloop` `main` @ `802de01`. No product changes (planning only).
- **Headline:** install works in ~3 min on all three platforms, but **time to first login is "never"** (F-003 unverified admin, F-005 registrations locked, F-004 no change-password). All documented backups are empty 86-byte archives that report success, and "full wipe" leaves the database (F-011). The manual Docker path runs with a published JWT secret; a forged verify token returned full login tokens (F-024). Results were identical on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Debian 13; the Ubuntu scripted run reproduced the novice run.
- **Deviations:** (1) Uninstall levels ran from a VM snapshot taken right after install instead of three fresh installs (ADR-0014). (2) Platforms ran in parallel; install times from those runs (147–193 s) are upper bounds; the solo novice run (2 min 55 s) is the reference. (3) Claude in Chrome was not connected; Nick chose a headless Playwright container (pinned `v1.63.0-noble`) for the UI screenshots. (4) The default admin was marked verified inside the container ("unlock") to audit P5–P8; labelled as a workaround everywhere. (5) Mail was tested by hand-editing the compose file (the only way today; F-030). (6) P10 on Ubuntu only, as the prompt allows; Cloudflare/Tailscale reviewed from docs. (7) Two scripted steps exited 2 after doing their work because `baseline.sh` was edited mid-run; results were checked by hand and the lesson recorded in `docs/LAB.md`.
- **Later prompts changed:** 06–10 each gained a "Phase 04 evidence" block (seed account is `seed@chessloop.local` and fails at syntax level; nginx health check also broken; the stray empty `chessloop-data` volume; placeholder JWT secret; compose bind default; failed installs not resumable; measured install time/disk/RAM; the 22 doc inaccuracies; official Caddy method; Funnel vs Serve).
- **Follow-ups:** F-020 (Lichess explorer now needs a token) is outside ADR-0002's scope: reported to Nick; a candidate `/phase-add` if he wants it fixed. Phase 05 should reuse `lab/baseline.sh` steps where they apply inside WSL.

- **Headline:** the installer runs unchanged in WSL (Engine: exit 0 in 253-322 s), and Edge on Windows opens `http://localhost:8090`. But WSL stops Ubuntu ~15 s after its window closes and nothing starts it after a restart, so ChessLoop vanishes (F-036). `wsl --install` needs two runs and gives Ubuntu 26.04 unless 24.04 is named (F-037, F-038). LAN needs Windows-side steps (F-040). Docker Desktop: the installer fails in 6 s without WSL integration (F-041) and ChessLoop stays down after every restart because of nginx's file bind mount (F-042). Tested workaround for F-036 with no admin rights: `.wslconfig` `instanceIdleTimeout=-1` + a Startup-folder `ChessLoop.cmd` (survived window close and a restart).
- **Deviations:** (1) No `distrobuilder repack-windows` (ADR-0016): NVMe disk + USB media, a no-prompt EFI remaster in a pinned container, SSH as the control channel (WSL can't run as SYSTEM via the Incus agent). (2) Sam's first-run username prompt can't be typed over SSH; `wsl-user` creates the same user. Commands that need sam's desktop session (the `wsl.exe` stub, Docker Desktop's credential helper, Edge) run as `/IT` scheduled tasks. (3) Sam's default path got Ubuntu 26.04 (what `wsl --install` gives today); 24.04 was baselined separately from `wsl-ready`. (4) Docker Desktop's WSL integration was switched on through its settings file (same keys as the Settings page) and the installer then run from the desktop session. (5) The Docker Desktop installer was run with `--accept-license` (Docker Subscription Service Agreement; lab use = personal use). (6) The first install attempt on 26.04 failed in the harness (sudo-rs prompt) and was re-run after fixing `drive-deploy.exp`. (7) A one-off `wsl.exe` hang (26.04, Ubuntu window open) did not reproduce on 24.04 and is recorded as an observation only.
- **Later prompts changed:** 07 (F-042: remove the nginx file bind mount; verify on `desktop-ready` with a restart), 08 (WSL facts, keep-alive, Docker Desktop shim detection, LAN wording, lab drivers and snapshots), 09 (WSL autostart = ADR-0017, test with a Windows restart), 10 (Windows guide content per ADR-0017), 11 (`wsl --install` needs the desktop session in the lab), 13 (real-PC checks the lab couldn't do).
- **Follow-ups:** owner question 8 (Ubuntu 26.04; accept ADR-0017). The Windows evaluation expires 2027-01-15 (rebuild with `win11.sh create`, ~1 h unattended). The VM needs 8 GiB of RAM: stop it after use.
- **Host:** packages `swtpm`, `cdrtools`, `virt-viewer` (Nick ran pacman); media and the lab SSH key in `~/Work/chessloop-lab-media/` (17 GB, outside git); host Docker image `debian:trixie-slim` pinned by digest; VM `cl-win11` (stopped). Documented in OSMods `Incus Test Lab.md` and its README.
- **Tests:** the prompt's test: reset to `wsl-ready` and re-run P1: **same result** (exit 0, 288 s vs 322 s; the installer's 33 status lines identical; probe and Windows access identical). `lab/lint.sh` (ShellCheck, 13 files) clean; secret scan of the new `runs/` (lab password, JWT, keys) empty; all screenshots checked by eye.
